intro.text: A nation of Dayside and one of the Rim Kingdoms.

description.text: It lies on Dayside's eastern coast, with Denka to the north and Tallon to the south. Mountains form its western border, with a way through in the northwest to the northern deep sand. Its cities include Reveln.

items.text: Lossand's Lord General suspected King Reven of Seevis of offering to hire sand masters.
